propositions: RunawayPaginationError subclasses RuntimeError instead of BackendPaginationStallError, placing it outside the core stall type hierarchy
fetch_snapshot's three enrichment re-raise clauses (parent, comment, issuelink) match on BackendPaginationStallError and miss Cloud stalls, allowing broad except Exception handlers to swallow them
Cloud cursor stalls produce silently degraded snapshots written with missing parent, comment, and issuelink data instead of propagating to abort the pass
RunawayPaginationError must be changed to subclass BackendPaginationStallError so the existing fetcher re-raise clauses can catch and propagate it
Ordinary non-stall enrichment failures must continue to fail open and write degraded snapshots as negative control
The fix preserves existing except RunawayPaginationError sites and except RuntimeError sites unedited via the inheritance chain
